content.text:
This is a self-contained demo dashboard used inside an MDX case-study page with no props and no attacker-controllable inputs. Everything is deterministic mock data.

Trace summary of each file:

- **WatchtowerModulesSandbox.tsx**: no props, no state, only renders static child cards. No sinks.
- **mockData.ts**: all values are hardcoded literals or produced by a deterministic seeded PRNG (mulberry32). No I/O, no external input.
- **types.ts, graphMeasurements.ts**: pure functions (Intl.DateTimeFormat, arithmetic). No sinks.
- **BandwidthCard/CpuUtilizationCard/NetworkSpeedCard/RamUsageCard/DiskSpaceCard.tsx**: consume the static mockData and render recharts components. `activeIndex` comes from recharts' own `state.activeTooltipIndex` on mouse events over static data — used only as an array index in-bounds by construction. No sinks.
- **StatHighlight.tsx**: `iconColor`, `valueColor`, `changeColor` inline-style values are supplied only as compile-time string literals or CSS var names from the card parents. React inline-style values cannot inject arbitrary CSS declarations (each object key is a single property), so even if these strings were tainted (they aren't), no ";url(javascript:...)" style escape is possible. Content is rendered as text children — no XSS.
- **WtCard.tsx**: `backgroundImage`, `footerBgColor` style values are static parent-supplied constants (`"var(--wt-demo-cpu-card-bg)"`, `"var(--wt-demo-danger-bg-strong)"`). Same inline-style safety as above. `children`/`footer` are React nodes, not HTML strings.
- **WtInfoTooltip.tsx**: `message` is a static compile-time string, rendered as text (JSX child) and passed to `aria-label`. No DOM injection.
- **HoverDateTooltip.tsx**: reads `payload[0].payload.time` (a number from mockData), guards with `time == null`, passes to `Intl.DateTimeFormat`. Rendered as text. Safe.
- **Bars.tsx**: `x, y, width, height` come from recharts' bar geometry (numbers). Interpolated into an SVG `path` `d` attribute (attribute value, not markup) — recharts numbers, not user input.
- **MeasureBar.tsx**: `percentage` is a static number from `mockData.diskSpace`, clamped 0–100 before use.

No entry points (HTTP handlers, IPC, user forms, URL params), no dangerous sinks (`dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, `eval`, `exec`, `fs`, SQL, outbound HTTP), no deserialization, no logging of sensitive values, no auth logic, no cross-file data flow from untrusted sources.
